description: Free, no API key. Returns dated basic facts for one UK company from official records: status, age, late filings, insolvency notice, and whether a director ban in force is on record. Company-level facts only. Indicators only, not advice. For a risk score and joined register checks, use risk_assess with an API key. Returns JSON with fields companyNumber, companyName, status, incorporatedOn, accountsOverdue, confirmationStatementOverdue, insolvencyNoticeOnRecord, latestInsolvencyNotice, petitionOnRecord, directorBanInForceOnRecord, recordsCheckedOn, recordDate, validUntil, source, liveUrl. When no record exists it returns companyNumber, found false and notice. The optional fields input keeps only the named fields. Each answer states its record date and its source.

companyNumber.description: UK Companies House registration number, 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

fields.description: Optional. Field names to keep in the result, for example ["companyNumber","status"]. Unknown names are ignored. companyNumber is always kept.

name: company_status

found.description: False when no record exists for the company number.

title: UK company status
